title: 第1510章 战史涛无耻之徒第1509章 金龙蜕变震宵小
content_zh:
陈青海的传音在史涛识海中响起：“小心些，此子能收服金龙，绝非表面修为那般简单。”
史涛嘴角勾起一抹冷笑，眼中战意如焰，同样传音回道：“陈老放心，区区轮回境五重天，就算他有些手段，在我白银龙族面前也不够看。我自会将修为压至与他同境，让他输得心服口服！”
话音落下，史涛身形骤然化作一道银色流光，向玄重星外的星河虚无境疾驰而去。
陈青海深深看了林玄一眼，拱了拱手，转身化为青光紧随其后。
林玄握了握秦有容的手，低声道：“等我。”
秦有容轻点螓首，那双金色龙瞳中倒映着他的身影，轻声说：“小心他的力量本源，白银龙族以力破万法着称。”
林玄点头，身形一闪，化作剑光冲天而起。
四人先后降临在玄重星附近的星河虚无境内。
四周是无尽的幽暗虚空，远处星辉闪烁，脚下空无一物，只有冷寂的宇宙尘埃缓缓飘荡。这里远离一切星辰引力，是最适合放手一搏的战斗之地。
史涛负手而立，银色长发在虚空中无风自动，一身白色战袍猎猎作响。他目光如刀刺向林玄，沉声道：“银龙圣史涛，请赐教！”
林玄凌空而立，右手虚握，九劫剑化为一柄通体青碧的长剑落入掌中，剑身细密龙鳞般的纹路泛起幽光。
“林玄。”
二字落下，战端骤起。
史涛身形暴射而出，右拳裹挟着刺目的白银龙力，拳罡撕碎虚空，直轰林玄面门。
这一拳快到极致，银光所过之处，空间如镜面般寸寸碎裂。
林玄脚下步伐玄妙变幻，身体在毫厘之间侧移，拳罡擦着他脸颊轰过，刮起的厉风削断他几缕发丝。他眼神冰冷，手腕翻转，九劫剑化作青冥剑形态斜斩而出。
刷——
一道墨青色的剑光撕裂虚空，银蛇般的青冥剑气蜿蜒而至，瞬间斩在史涛回防的左臂上。
铛！！
金铁交鸣之声响彻虚无境，史涛左臂上的银色龙鳞浮现，硬生生扛下这一剑，但整个人被剑气上蕴含的恐怖力量震得连退十步。

每一步踏下，虚空都在他脚下炸开一圈涟漪。
史涛稳住身形，低头看了一眼左臂上那道浅浅的白痕，眼底闪过一丝凝重，随即咧嘴一笑：“有点意思。”
他双拳在胸前一撞，拳套上银光暴涨。
“五阶金龙拳——”
史涛低吼一声，体内白银龙力如火山喷发般涌出，在身后凝聚出一条盘旋咆哮的巨大银龙虚影。那银龙虚影仰天长啸，龙威浩荡，连远处的星辰光芒都被压得黯淡三分。
他一拳轰出，白银龙力化作一道栩栩如生的金龙气劲破空而出。
那龙气所过之处，空间崩塌，虚无扭曲，其中蕴含着一股令天地万物都为之震颤的力量本源。这不是普通的龙力，而是白银龙族血脉中传承的纯粹力量——以力证道，一力降十会！
林玄眼眸微眯，九劫剑在掌心一转，青冥剑身上青焰骤燃。
“三转极限·焚天真青冥剑！”
他体内功法运转，轮回之力注入剑中，青冥剑气上燃起诡异的青色火焰。那火焰并非凡火，而是以剑意催发的焚天之焰，能将一切物质焚烧成最原始的能量粒子。
剑出。
青色火龙咆哮而出，与金龙气劲在虚无境中央轰然对撞。
轰！！！
两股力量碰撞的瞬间，方圆千里的虚空同时炸裂，无数空间碎片如暴雨般飞溅。耀眼的光芒将整片虚无境照得宛如白昼。
史涛的金龙气劲与林玄的焚天真青冥剑气相互吞噬、撕扯，最终同时湮灭。
然而，就在金龙气劲消散的刹那，焚天真青冥剑的后劲骤然爆发！一股无形的青色火浪穿透爆炸中心，直扑史涛面门！
史涛瞳孔骤缩，双臂交叉护在胸前。
嘭！！
他被这股后劲轰得倒飞出数十丈，双臂上的银色龙鳞被烧得微微发红，战袍袖口更是化为灰烬。
“后劲……”

史涛咬牙稳住身形，手臂上传来阵阵灼痛。
林玄眉头微皱。他察觉到了——焚天真青冥剑的后劲在穿透金龙气劲时，被那股力量本源强行削弱了至少三成。否则这一剑足以将史涛双臂烧成焦炭。
力量本源……竟能对剑术后劲产生克制？
“很好！”史涛眼中闪过暴虐之色，“你成功惹怒我了！”
content_en:
Chen Qinghai's message sounded in Shi Tao's sea of consciousness: "Be careful, this son's ability to conquer the golden dragon is by no means as simple as his superficial cultivation."
A sneer appeared at the corner of Shi Tao's mouth, with fighting spirit in his eyes, and he replied through the same voice: "Don't worry, Mr. Chen, he is only in the fifth level of the reincarnation realm. Even if he has some tricks, they are not enough in front of my Silver Dragon Clan. I will push my cultivation to the same level as him, so that he can be convinced of his defeat!"
As soon as he finished speaking, Shi Tao's figure suddenly turned into a stream of silver light, speeding towards the void realm of the galaxy outside Xuanzhong Star.
Chen Qinghai took a deep look at Lin Xuan, cupped his hands, turned around and turned into green light and followed closely.
Lin Xuan shook Qin Yourong's hand and whispered, "Wait for me."
Qin Yourong nodded lightly, his figure reflected in the golden dragon eyes, and said softly: "Be careful about the source of his power. The Silver Dragon Clan is famous for its power to defeat all kinds of magic."
Lin Xuan nodded, his figure flashed, and turned into sword light soaring into the sky.
The four of them descended on the void territory of the galaxy near Xuanzhong Star.
Surrounded by endless dark void, stars twinkled in the distance, and there was nothing beneath his feet, only the cold and silent cosmic dust floating slowly. This place is far away from all the gravity of the stars, and is the most suitable place for a fight.
Shi Tao stood with his hands behind his back, his long silver hair floating in the windless air, and his white shirt making a hunting sound. His gaze was like a knife piercing Lin Xuan, and he said in a deep voice: "Silver Dragon Saint Shi Tao, please enlighten me!"
Lin Xuan stood in the air, holding his right hand empty. The Nine Tribulations Sword turned into a long blue sword and fell into his palm. The fine lines like dragon scales on the sword body glowed with a faint light.
"Lin Xuan."
As soon as the two words fell, the battle suddenly started.
Shi Tao's body shot out, his right fist wrapped in the dazzling silver dragon power, the fist tore apart the void, and hit Lin Xuan's face directly.
This punch was so fast that wherever the silver light passed, the space was shattered like a mirror.
Lin Xuan's steps changed mysteriously, his body moved sideways in the slightest, the fist grazed his cheek, and the strong wind cut off several strands of his hair. His eyes were cold, he flipped his wrist, and the Nine Tribulations Sword transformed into the Qingming Sword and slashed out diagonally.
Brush——
A streak of dark blue sword light tore through the void, and the silver snake-like Qingming Sword Qi snaked towards Shi Tao's defensive left arm.
clang! !
The sound of gold and iron clashing echoed through the void, and the silver dragon scales on Shi Tao's left arm emerged. He was forced to bear the sword, but his whole body was shaken by the terrifying power contained in the sword energy and he took ten steps back.
With every step he took, the void exploded with ripples beneath his feet.
Shi Tao steadied his body and glanced down at the shallow white mark on his left arm. A trace of solemnity flashed in his eyes, and then he grinned: "It's interesting."
He bumped his fists against his chest, and the silver light on his gloves surged.
"Fifth level Golden Dragon Fist——"
Shi Tao roared, and the silver dragon power in his body surged out like a volcano erupting, condensing a huge hovering and roaring silver dragon shadow behind him. The phantom of the silver dragon looked up to the sky and roared. The dragon's power was so majestic that even the light of the stars in the distance was dimmed by three points.
He punched out, and the silver dragon power turned into a lifelike golden dragon energy and shot out of the air.
Wherever the dragon energy passed, the space collapsed and nothingness was distorted. It contained the source of power that made everything in the world tremble. This is not ordinary dragon power, but the pure power inherited from the bloodline of the Silver Dragon Clan - prove the Tao with force, conquer ten levels with one force!
Lin Xuan narrowed his eyes slightly, turned the Nine Tribulations Sword in his palm, and the green flames on the Qingming Sword suddenly ignited.
"Third-turn limit: Burning Heavenly Green Underworld Sword!"
The skills in his body were running, the power of reincarnation was injected into the sword, and a strange green flame ignited on the Qingming Sword Qi. That flame is not an ordinary fire, but a sky-burning flame activated by sword intent, which can burn all matter into the most primitive energy particles.
The sword comes out.
The cyan fire dragon roared out and collided with the golden dragon's energy in the center of the void realm.
boom! ! !
The moment the two forces collided, the void with a radius of thousands of miles exploded at the same time, and countless space debris splashed like a rainstorm. dazzlingThe light illuminated the entire void like daylight.
Shi Tao's Golden Dragon Qi and Lin Xuan's Burning Heaven Qingming Sword Qi devoured and tore each other apart, and were eventually annihilated at the same time.
However, at the moment when the golden dragon's energy dissipated, the stamina of Fen Tianqing Mingjian suddenly exploded! An invisible blue wave of fire penetrated the center of the explosion and hit Shi Tao's face!
Shi Tao's pupils shrank suddenly and he crossed his arms to protect his chest.
Bang! !
He was blown back dozens of feet by the force. The silver dragon scales on his arms were burned slightly red, and the cuffs of his shirt were reduced to ashes.
"Stamina..."
Shi Tao gritted his teeth and stabilized his body, feeling burning pain in his arms.
Lin Xuan frowned slightly. He noticed that - when the stamina of Fentian Qingming Sword penetrated the golden dragon energy, it was forcibly weakened by the source of that power by at least 30%. Otherwise, this sword would be enough to burn Shi Tao's arms into coke.
The source of power... can actually restrain the swordsmanship?
"Very good!" A cruel look flashed in Shi Tao's eyes, "You succeeded in irritating me!"
